_comment: Fine-tuned LoRA adapters Friday may install as their own seats (services/adapter_seats). Each entry pins the adapter's sha256: only that exact file installs. source is where the file is found, relative to Friday's home; the app takes no path from a request. base_from names the store record whose weights and projector the seat reuses; that record is never modified, so it stays the one-step rollback.
